headline: Executive order creates a White House initiative focused on improving education for Hispanic students.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics. Based on the title, its purpose is to focus federal attention on the education of Hispanic Americans. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies take part, what the initiative must do, and any funding are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is aimed at improving educational outcomes for Hispanic Americans.
The order directs the federal government to run a White House initiative on this issue, though the exact duties are not stated in the source.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 19, 2010; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
